name: Blood of My Blood
summary: A kin of the Lost Ones asks you to end their suffering in Fallow Sanctuary. Their violence threatens those who remain.

sections.title: A Grim Request
sections.body: In Fallow Sanctuary, one of the Lost Ones asks you to protect those still living there. The Lost Ones have become violent and hateful, and their kin sees no hope of redemption or salvation for them. You are asked to end their suffering by putting them out of their misery.

faq.answer: A Lost One asks you to protect those who remain in Fallow Sanctuary.

faq.q: Why are the Lost Ones feared?
faq.answer: The Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of violence and hatred.

faq.q: Can the Lost Ones be saved?
faq.answer: Their kin believes there can be no redemption or salvation for the Lost Ones.

faq.q: Why are you asked to kill them?
faq.answer: Their kin believes the Lost Ones are suffering and asks you to end that suffering to protect those who remain.

attribution: In-game quest text: Blood of My Blood
